description: I know a lot about coding and have worked with python many times in the past. I think it's really cool to design games and basically joined to have a fun time. :)
summary: I wanted to find a fun and quick game that showed tiny fun facts to kids. In this case, my little sister, 9-year-old, was my little judge for this project and she helped me choose the images and what happened in the game. I just want to say that, even if it is not the best, it has a lot of though behind it and it was a fun experience to participate. Thanks for reading this :)
details: Our project is a 5-minute mini-game for kids and teenagers. Players take the role of an astronaut and go on a short journey from Earth to Mars. The goal is to make space exploration fun and encourage curiosity about Mars. The game was created using Rosebud AI. Its creativity comes from combining a simple space adventure with colorful visuals and an entertaining experience designed for younger audiences.
dataRefs: 07 Mars Mars, the red planet, is the seventh largest planet in our solar system. Mars is about half the width of Earth, and has an equatorial diameter of about 4,221 miles (6,792 kilometers). Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun, orbiting at an average distance of 141.6 million miles (227.9 million kilometers). Mars is about 49 million miles (79 million kilometers) farther from the Sun than Earth.
